node.title: Re: utime for symbolic links
node.author: Fletch
node.doctext:
My guess is that touch -h is using the lutimes(3) system call (where available) which a quick ripgrep through the perl source doesn't show any reference to. You theoretically could wrap it directly yourself with [mod://Inline::C] but I don't think you're otherwise going to have luck directly from perl.
